clean.root_cause: The agent never located an egg because it did not visit the diningtable or fridge, where eggs commonly appear.
clean.evidence: After exploring countertops and cabinets, the agent returned to countertop 2 without ever going to diningtable or fridge.
clean.corrective_rule: When tasked to clean an object, first search all countertops, dining tables, and fridge before opening cabinets.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Missing a prioritized search order for common object locations in the clean task.
clean.patch_location: Under '## clean', add a new subsection '### locate target object' with a rule to search surfaces and fridge first.

clean.root_cause: The agent did not explore all cabinets and countertops for the plate, stopping after one empty cabinet.
clean.evidence: After opening cabinet 1 (empty), the agent returned to countertop 1 without checking the remaining 12 cabinets.
clean.corrective_rule: When searching for a specific object, open all cabinets in the room, not just the first one encountered.
clean.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a systematic cabinet-by-cabinet search routine in the clean task.
clean.patch_location: Under '## clean' -> '### locate target object', add a step to iterate through all cabinets.

cool.root_cause: The agent never found an apple and failed to open the fridge properly, so it could not cool any object.
cool.evidence: After opening fridge, observation still said 'The fridge 1 is closed', indicating the open action did not succeed, and no apple was seen elsewhere.
cool.corrective_rule: After moving to the fridge, verify the open action changes state; if not, re-navigate and try again. Also search for the apple on all surfaces and inside the fridge.
cool.skill_tree_gap: No verification of container state after opening and incomplete search for apples.
cool.patch_location: Under '## cool', add a subsection '### open container' with state verification, and expand '### locate object' to include fridge interior.

pick_and_place.root_cause: The agent did not search all countertops and cabinets for the soapbottle, missing likely locations.
pick_and_place.evidence: After opening cabinet 4 (empty), it returned to countertop 1 without exploring other areas like diningtable or shelf.
pick_and_place.corrective_rule: When tasked to place an object, search all visible surfaces and open every cabinet until the object is found.
pick_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Incomplete object search routine for pick_and_place tasks.
pick_and_place.patch_location: Under '## pick_and_place', add a new subsection '### locate object' with exhaustive search instructions.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: After placing the first pen, the agent did not exhaustively search all drawers and shelves for a second pen.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: It only checked drawer 8 (empty) and then looped back to desk and bed without opening other drawers or shelves.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: When needing two identical objects, continue searching all receptacles (drawers, shelves, surfaces) until two are found or all are exhausted.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Lack of exhaustive multiple-object search strategy.
pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: Under '## pick_two_obj_and_place', add a subsection '### exhaustive search' that mandates checking all drawers, shelves, and surfaces.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent limited its search to cabinets only, ignoring countertops and dining tables where spoons are often found.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: After opening cabinet 6, it ended without ever visiting countertops or the diningtable.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: When searching for spoons, check countertops and dining tables in addition to cabinets.

pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: For pans, prioritize checking stoveburners and countertops before cabinets.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: The agent stopped after picking up one ladle, without placing it or searching for a second ladle.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: The last action is 'take ladle 2 from countertop 1' and then the trajectory ends with no further actions.
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After picking up an object, immediately proceed to the next subgoal (place or find second object) without stopping.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Missing a continuation check after each pick action in multi-object tasks.
pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: Under '## pick_two_obj_and_place', add a subsection '### progress verification' that ensures the agent does not stop mid-task.

pick_two_obj_and_place.patch_location: Under '## pick_two_obj_and_place', add a subsection '### loop detection' to identify and break repetitive patterns.

pick_two_obj_and_place.root_cause: After placing the first cellphone, the agent got stuck in a loop between armchair1 and bed1, never seeking a second cellphone elsewhere.
pick_two_obj_and_place.evidence: Repeated actions: go to armchair1, bed1, armchair1, bed1... (continuous loop).
pick_two_obj_and_place.corrective_rule: After placing the first object, if the second is not found in the immediate area, expand the search to all remaining receptacles in the room.
pick_two_obj_and_place.skill_tree_gap: Lack of a strategy to transition from partial success to full exploration.
